correctness.rationale: Reconstructed the two-run/four-run root dichotomy from first/last symbols and four source runs. Four-run identical roots force q-divisibility of every run; two-run roots 0^A1^B need k complete early copies with ceil(b/B)<=k<=floor(a/A), and the constructive allocation realizes them. Inclusion-exclusion over qA-1 by qB-1 run compositions gives the floor-sum formula; fixed-q Riemann floors yield density (q^3-q^2+q+1)/(2q^3), whose derivative (q-3)(q+1)/(2q^4) proves unique integer minimum at q=3. Independent explicit interleaving-state search for 34 small cases and arithmetic count checks for 448 cells agreed.
residual_risks: Finite comparisons cannot prove all q,A,B; the symbolic root structure and sums carry the universal argument.
